description.value: Skewers Souvlaki Pita Bar brings authentic Greek street food to Commercial Drive, one of Vancouver's most popular cycling corridors. The kitchen uses BC-farmed chicken and pork alongside New Zealand lamb sirloin, marinated in-house for twelve hours in Greek olive oil and Mediterranean herbs, with every dish cut and prepared fresh daily. From classic pork gyro pitas to mixed grill platters and Cretan salads, it's a satisfying and affordable refuelling stop on a long urban ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM name, phone, and Commercial Drive address. A secondary address (26 Powell St) appears prominently in what looks like a header/banner block throughout the site, with different hours, suggesting a second location may be under development or was recently added to the site template — this warrants a flag. The menu page lists Halloumi Cheese pita and multiple salads, confirming vegetarian options; the site repeatedly promotes online ordering and phone pickup, confirming takeout. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Website displays a secondary address '26 Powell St, Vancouver, BC V6A 1E7' with a distinct set of hours in a recurring banner/header block across all pages; this may indicate a second location being added to the site or a template populated with a different branch's data. The main body content consistently references 1851 Commercial Dr.
Opening hours shown on the website are inconsistent across page sections (three different sets of hours appear on some pages), suggesting the site template is not fully updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active Greek restaurant on Commercial Drive — a high-traffic cycling route — with confirmed takeout and vegetarian menu items; a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists Halloumi Cheese pita wrap, Mixed Salad with Feta, Greek Salad, and Cretan Salad — all vegetarian options
